candidate.title: TIVA
candidate.scope: TIVA (Transcriptome In Vivo Analysis), specifically the middle-row schematic of a CPP-delivered, disulfide-linked, photocaged biotinylated poly-U capture tag used to recover mRNA from a spatially selected live cell. Inventory: Whole-genome RNA/AA(A)n target icon; input tag labeled Biotin, Cy3, Cy5, CPP, S-S and PL; a Cell compartment; Load into cells, CPP peptide released, Photoactivate, Anneal to mRNA, Capture on Streptavidin coated magnetic beads, and mRNA from single cell. The PL/CPP/disulfide legend belongs to this row. The neighboring CirSeq and PAIR rows are separate context, with no connecting route or alternative TIVA workflow. The graph ends at recovered mRNA. Source text clarifies the downstream amplified-RNA-to-cDNA sequencing-library interface, which is not drawn and is not expanded into additional operations. Single-cell association is established by spatially targeted uncaging before lysis and affinity recovery.
